content:
taylor: Quick heads-up  two arrivals at 10:30: a visiting panelist (Ms. Gomez) arriving with a foldable walker and three small parcels from two different couriers. Also note: the badge printer at front desk is acting flaky.

frontdesk-bot: Visitors scheduled: Ms. A. Gomez (panelist), ETA 10:30, host: taylor. Couriers: FastShip (1 package) + LocalDrop (2 packages), check-in links: https://intranet/checkin/xyz789

henry: Thanks. Two immediate asks: 1) can someone prep an accessible chair near reception? 2) confirm if we can accept multiple courier packages under different sender names.

maya: Accessible folding chair reserved at reception. For packages: front desk can accept, but please log BOL and courier name. If labels differ from expected host, call the host to confirm before signing.

linda: Also: badge printer error 503 sometimes. If it fails, please use the spare sheet badges (sticker roll) in Drawer A and note in the log "printed on sticker". I'm heading over to swap the toner.

noah: I'll bring a small ramp mat and help fold the walker area if needed. Also will queue the temporary sticker badges just in case.

frontdesk-bot: Alert: badge printer error reported at 09:58. Flagging for ops.

ops: Ops here: We're on the way to swap the thermal roll and clear the jam. ETA 12 mins. In the interim, use sticker badges and log `printer_fallback` in the visitor sheet.

taylor: For the packages: one courier is dropping a small prop kit (LocalDrop) and the other is a jar of commemorative cookies (FastShip) for the panel. Please ask the courier to confirm recipient name before leaving. If any food: label and fridge policy applies.

maya: Noted. If cookies are opened, ask them to be kept in common fridge in labeled guest box. If sealed, they can stay in reception for 20 mins.

linda: Printer swap done. Thermal roll replaced and jam cleared. Test badge OK. Sorry for the ping-panic.

frontdesk-bot: Visitor checked in: Ms. A. Gomez. Badge printed. Note: "walker - needs seat".

henry: Ms. Gomez is here. Walker folds down fine and the accessible chair helps. Couriers checked in and I verified BOLs. Two parcels logged under `taylor_panel_2026-03-23` (FastShip: cookies, LocalDrop: prop kit).

noah: I placed a small mat by the front door and helped move one parcel to Conference Corner B (host requested).

taylor: Thank you all! Quick update for future: if guest notes mobility aid in calendar invite, front desk will pre-reserve the accessible chair and flag the badge as "needs seat". Also please leave courier BOL copies in the delivery folder. Saves calls. :raised_hands:

maya: Adding that as a 1-line update to the playbook now.

ops: FYI we'll add a printer health check to the morning checklist so the thermal roll/peel sensor is looked at 9am daily.

linda: And I'll restock the sticker badge pack.

frontdesk-bot: Thread closed: visitor processed and packages logged."
